name: Florida Mesh (LongFast, most of the state)
area: North West, North, Central West and Central East Florida, and South Florida outside the southeast coast

mqtt.advice: Florida Mesh runs its own MQTT server, which now requires an account; see their MQTT page.

notes: Their page says to leave the frequency slot on 0 (automatic), which is slot 20 with the default channel name. Set 20 by hand only if you rename the primary channel.
Jacksonville and Duval County, and the southeast coast from Sebastian to Layton Key, use MediumFast instead; see the other Florida Mesh entry.
Brevard County is listed as a dual LongFast and MediumFast area.
